reviews.title: I like the premise but the app is buggy
reviews.text: I like what Hatch does but the app is not the most user friendly even for a fairly tech savvy person like myself. There are several simple app bugs I’ve encountered just in my first week of using it. Example: when I try to create a new alarm it doesn’t appear on my Home Screen until close out and relaunch the app. Also, there are multiple slots for different wind down routines but when I try to create these new wind down routines, the activities just get stacked onto the first wind down routine and the other open slots remain blank. Also, the app lets you set different alarms for different days of the week (I like this) but does not allow you to do the same with cues or unwinds…anyway, I like the premise and the lights are nice. Sound library is good enough. But the app is detracting from the value I get out of this

reviews.title: Convoluted user interface
reviews.text:
I genuinely cannot understand how an app for a sound machine can be this frustrating to use.

The scheduling system is unbelievably poorly designed. You can choose what time a routine starts, but instead of simply choosing an end time, Hatch makes you enter a duration in hours and minutes. So if I want one routine to end at 8:30 and another to begin at 8:31, I literally have to calculate how many hours and minutes the first routine needs to run. Why am I doing time arithmetic to program a sound machine?

It gets even worse when you have multiple schedules. The app complains that schedules “overlap,” but rather than letting you simply look at start and end times and fix the conflict, you have to go back and calculate durations yourself. Apparently even disabled schedules can create conflicts.

Then some sounds have fixed durations that cannot be changed. One schedule was inexplicably stuck at 9 minutes, with virtually no useful explanation from the app.

This is a sound machine for a child’s bedroom. Scheduling should be: start at 8:30 PM, stop at 6:30 AM, repeat on these days. Done. Instead, Hatch has somehow turned setting a bedtime into a math problem while simultaneously creating an “overlap” system that fights you every step of the way.

reviews.text: The old hatch was easy to operate, didn’t force music categories per routine (you could play whatever you wanted from the library) and whenever you wanted it (tap to play). The new app, devices and setup is patronizingly prescriptive and frustrating. Wish I could unbuy the new devices and go back to the old ones. Terrible product management.

reviews.title: So many bugs
reviews.text: This app has so many bugs in it. It’s impossible to set a sunrise alarm easily - there’s always errors happening or issues occurring. If you want to change the time on the alarm, sometimes it works - other times, it doesn’t. I constantly get mad at it every night for not adjusting or requiring multiple instances to change/edit the alarm. There’s gotta be other sunrise/sunset alarms out there by now.

reviews.title: Love the alarm, app is okay.
reviews.text: Ever since I have had the alarm my sleep has been amazing and I was up great in the mornings, as someone who sleeps through about every alarm. Only issue is the app is very glitchy and doesn’t save my alarms sometimes.

reviews.title: Love the hatch hate the app
reviews.text: Absolutely love the alarm clock but the app is very frustrating. Half the time the app won’t let you edit alarms and if it does it won’t save them.

reviews.title: Glitchy
reviews.text: Give yourself a favor and get a cheap little sound machine. The app is not working half of the time. It is super sensitive. If you tried to exit out of the app in the middle of the night, it will randomly start playing songs. It’s just not what I thought it would be. Also, they really want you to pay that ridiculous $50 annual fee or five dollars a month in order to have access to their app and their product. The audacity. They still have free little bedtime stories which they took away as well.

reviews.title: Could be a lot better
reviews.text: Take forever to load! Has been really glitchy lately. It was a lot to have to buy the product and a subscription only for it to not work properly

reviews.title: Product great, App not
reviews.text: This is an excellent product that helps with sleeping and rising. I’ve used it for years now. Unfortunately, this review is of the APP, which is pretty terrible. Extremely slow, constant connectivity issues, and regular crashes make it inconvenient and frustrating to use.

reviews.title: Inconvenient and annoying
reviews.text: A scam, difficult to use, and deceiving

reviews.title: You Will Have to Subscribe to the App
reviews.text: There are hardly any free alarms on the app. If you want to wake up with this without paying for the app you will spend most of your time searching for the free options than you will actually using this alarm clock. I’m already paying for an expensive alarm. Why do I have to pay for the app, too?

reviews.title: Try again button still not working. Not sure what bugs keep getting fixed/improved
reviews.text: It has been several updates and no fix yet. Bluetooth off- open app -(cant connect as expected)- turn bluetooth on- Hit Try again button , nothing happens , but if you hit settings then done , it will refresh and show all devices

reviews.title: Stingy
reviews.text: Extremely stingy for a $200 alarm clock. You can't even set it up without giving these people your credit card information 👎

reviews.title: Doesn’t work for college students
reviews.text: I have probably wasted over 24 hours trying to get my hatch restore 3 to work. I am a college student and I need an alarm to be able to wake me up in the morning and I was so excited when I saved up to buy my first hatch. after taking a long time to be able to find that MAC address to be able to connect it to my student Wi-Fi in my dorm. My hatch would still not connect to the Wi-Fi and it would only connect to the hotspot on my phone. I went to customer service to try to get this fixed but customer service said that unfortunately I would only be able to connect the hatch to my hotspot on my phone. normally that would be fine, but when it’s connected to the hotspot on my phone, I cannot connect to the Wi-Fi. I told customer support this and they said that unfortunately I wouldn’t be able to have my phone connected to the Wi-Fi anymore while the hatch was connected to my hotspot. I have tried countless times to get it connected to the normal Wi-Fi and I have talked to many different customer support people from hatch and they have consistently been unhelpful. If you are a college student do NOT buy this product. Needless to say i will be returning my hatch and getting an Alexa because every other college student i have talked to with a hatch was forced to make the switch because the hatch cannot connect to the wi-fi or eduroam and will only connect to our phones hotspot. Every student i have talked to got rid of there hatch and switched to Alexa or a different alarm clock so just save yourself the time and do that before you move.

reviews.title: Meh
reviews.text: It’s a good app and I love my alarm but it’s super glitchy and slow every time I try to alter my alarm at night it’ll say I have an alarm at the same time when I don’t and it’s overall and frustrating app to try to work with.

reviews.title: Works, but unacceptably buggy
reviews.text: This app is so wildly buggy it’s absurd - they constantly ship updates which break things and the overall user experience is not great. Not acceptable for an app which requires a paid subscription on top of a paid product.

reviews.title: Trash
reviews.text: WiFi connecting within the app is awful, customer service is atrocious and this product hatch rest 2 is terrible. If you’re reading this it’s probably too late and you bought it, return it now and save the headache

reviews.title: Bugs in app
reviews.text: I have my font size set for one size above half on my iOS. You have to go into settings and reduce the size to the size just below half to make any type of adjustments so you see what you’re doing. This wouldn’t be a big problem if my eyesight was better but everyone gets older. Also it will not accept edits for bedtime and rise times.

reviews.title: Worst ever
reviews.text: The Hatch is absolutely not worth the money. I regret purchasing it. The app is impossible to use. It is bogged down with promotional information trying to force you into their subscriptions. Today a banner for a sale for some subscription blocked the whole app and I couldn’t change my child’s hatch to the wake up setting. Making it impossible to actually use a physical product in order to try to upsell their customers on a pointless subscription service is infuriating.

reviews.title: Needs to adjust the slider buttons
reviews.text: We love the hatch baby machine itself, but the app has a few issues that need to be worked out. One, it loads the main screen every time you go to it, which delays adjustments, which in the middle of the night, seconds are precious. The main issue I have is the slider buttons. So many times I have gone to adjust the light button in the middle of the night and it will also adjust the sound even without sliding it. It is very jarring when the sound jumps that much  and has awoken my baby multiple times. Would love to see a different way to adjust or spaced out better.

reviews.title: App Doesn’t work
reviews.text: Two nights in a row I’ve been woken up in the wee hours of the morning multiple times by the “sleep routine” starting all by itself for no reason like the device is possessed. The app will not let me delete the sleep routines. For the price I paid I don’t expect to have to jump through a single hoop to get the thing to work properly. So far my sleep has been worse from this thing.

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: Doesn’t work

reviews.title: Total Garbage
reviews.text: Forced to join membership. Had to call to cancel. Now can’t get unit to connect.  Documents and videos reference green light.  Unit does not show green light and documentation doesn’t even say where it is. On the bottom, on the front. It’s a complete mystery because it never turns on despite following the pairing process.  Two devices show up in the all, regardless of which one I select, I’m asked to enter network credentials to complete setup, I do and then nothing. No device in the app, nothing. Complete garbage.

reviews.title: Ux Feedback
reviews.text: Overall the app is great but as a UX designer and a mom to two under two I do wonder how much you are watching parents use the app while they are feeding their babies? Most of the time I am trying to feed with one hand and then try to raise the white noise volume or raise the night light brightness without the screen being right in there face so I’m usually doing it behind the arm chair arm and it would be nice if everything is bigger like the numbers for the scale elements to chair sound volume and light brightness. It would be great if there was a different way to switch between children because the reach up to the to left isn’t convenient when I’m holding the phone with one hand. It would be nice to have a Bluetooth only option. We have had a couple of storms in our area recently and when we lose power the white noise turns off for them and they wake up. If it could have Bluetooth option as well so I could play without being plugged in. I have the travel hatch but in the middle of the night it’s not convenient to find that in the dark and also having to go into their room which wakes them too. Happy to provide more feedback if needed! Thanks!!

reviews.title: Cluttered App
reviews.text: Hatch Restore is great but the app is so cluttered, overwhelming and overstimulating especially for something intended for calming the mind before sleep.  It’s annoying an app is needed anyway but they want your money, annoying it can only be on a phone and not desktop, who wants to be on their phone more and especially around kids at bedtime.  The features are cool but the entry way to them defeats the purpose IMHO.  Would be great if this functioned as a blue tooth speaker and we could play other material but again that’s how they intend to take more of your money.

reviews.title: App just doesn’t work
reviews.text: Can’t connect no matter what, very frustrating especially for the device price tag.

reviews.title: Great Basic Noise Machine… not-so-great Subscription
reviews.text: The basic white noise & other sounds (brown noise, rain, dryer, etc.) are great and we love them! The subscription for Hatch+ leaves something to be desired. Our connection waivers constantly despite our high internet speed, so we’ll be halfway into an audio only for it to stop abruptly, which makes bedtime harder (but isn’t Hatch supposed to help with that?). Will likely cancel our subscription and just use the basic sounds for sleep.

reviews.title: Sleep noise
reviews.text: I’ve had it for over a year now and I don’t think they’ve added any new sleep sounds. The options are very limited. Save yourself $ and buy a good Bluetooth speaker and download one of the many better apps.

reviews.title: Infuriatingly Slow
reviews.text: The physical product itself is fine.  It’s as good as any sound/light machine. But the app is so slow to load that after initial setup it’s essentially useless.  It takes literal minutes to connect, which is super fun when you’re trying to put your kids to bed, or raise the volume or adjust the light.

reviews.title: Lagging constantly
reviews.text: Incredibly laggy/fails to connect often.  I can never predict when the app will suddenly stop working. Sometimes I wake up and cannot even control my alarm because the app will not connect. When it works it is nice, but I suspect someone could set up something similar with a smart bulb and alarm clock without the constant connectivity and lagging issues.

reviews.title: Great device, really bad app
reviews.text: The app adds a lot of unneeded friction for the most basic stuff like creating an alarm

reviews.title: Keep malfunctioning
reviews.text: Keeps turning on at random times

reviews.title: Not good
reviews.text: It’s very slow, it closes out of the app once it times out. Which is very fast. And when you go to reopen it it takes too long. Like I’m trying to open it and then the light on asap. And touching the ring would switch to another sound I don’t want. So touching ring isn’t an answer. It also doesn’t always play and glitches. I wish the app would stay open so when I went to quickly change something I can.

reviews.title: Not worth it
reviews.text: Always disconnecting and lagging

reviews.title: App is buggy at the moment
reviews.text: The clock is good, but I cannot set up a new time because I’m constantly getting a bug in which the app thinks I already set the timer. If this were fixed I would enjoy it.

reviews.title: Needs some improvement
reviews.text: I like the Hatch 3, the light function, sound quality and design are nice — but the app is lacking. Music tends to repeat phrases way too quickly. It feels like bars instead of songs. The Call app is way ahead of this app in terms of variety and polish of the podcasts and music. It also seriously needs a loud traditional alarm sound option.

reviews.title: Alarm Clock Subscription??
reviews.text:
What happened to just buying something? I get that it’s a fancy white noise sunrise alarm clock, but does it really need to be a subscription service too? 
Half the things on the app seem to be locked unless I subscribe. Essentially the only reason to pay for it is to have the option to turn on the wind down setting via the app - any of the subscriber-only alarms or wind-downs have been middling at best, but sometimes cringe-worthy.

reviews.title: A little disappointed
reviews.text: The app is ok, but I’m surprised at the fact that you can’t play an external audio (like from your phone via Bluetooth).  Most of the cooler bedtime sound options are very new-agey (sound baths, mysticism, etc.) which makes that feature mostly useless for me.  I really would like to listen to the Bible as a wind down or sleep sound, but they don’t have it and there’s no way to add it.  So, the ability to play external audio, or just adding the Holy Bible would be a HUGE improvement!

reviews.title: 3 years later, still outraged at the failures and failures
reviews.text: Picture this - your kid has a fever, and you wake up at 4 am remembering the alarm is going to turn on at 6 am. You want them to sleep in. You think “great, I have an app for exactly this reason!” and open Hatch to turn off that alarm. NOPE, NO WIFI CONNECTION. Has it been sitting in the same spot for months? Has your WiFi been the EXACT SAME for years? WHY WHY WHY would it be disconnected, and why under the big blue sky would it require PHYSICAL RESET TO RECONNECT?????????? Again, WHY???? So I have to crawl silently through their room, TURN OFF THE DEVICE, wait for a super slow reboot, during which it is silent and the kid starts to wake up. It finally turns back on but wait! It’s reverted to old, deleted presets! So the color/sound combo your kid relys on can’t be found with the physical tap, instead it’s loud, random sounds. SO FUN FOR EVERYONE! and the app STILL does not control the device, so I still can’t change the alarm, but there’s no error message so also no clear reason to fix, at 4 am, holding your breath. So now instead of my sick kid waking at 6, they’re up at 4. So fun! And a scenario that never ever should’ve been built in, approved, or supported by a device with this purpose. GARBAGE. Why have these issues not been fixed, patched, whatever? Shame shame shame continues.

reviews.title: Update broke
reviews.text: Recent update broke my hatch. now the volume goes to max in its own. i turn the volume to zero and it goes right back to max. tried to reset same issue.

reviews.title: Alarm is great
reviews.text: Love the alarm!  Super sounds / features etc. I want to upgrade but refuse until I can consistently change my alarm on the first try on the app. Just took 4 tries! Unacceptable.

reviews.title: SLOW AF WHYYY
reviews.text: Why does this app take forever to open.. every time!?!

reviews.title: HORRIBLE APP
reviews.text: For $170 alarm clock this app feels like something free the Department of public safety would put out. It is not user-friendly. It’s difficult to edit the alarms. You have to go to multiple different places to do different things. I have a bachelors degree and I struggled setting our clocks up. Terrible app.

reviews.title: Terrible product - Not Reliable
reviews.text: The fact that a product that is essential your baby’s rest would require an internet connection to be optimal is absolutely abysmal. Terrible product and user experience within the app. Buyer beware.

reviews.title: Poor user experience
reviews.text: The concept behind the Hatch Restore is great, and I really wanted to love it, but the app makes everything much more complicated than it needs to be. The interface is not intuitive at all, and even simple things like setting an alarm or changing a sound take way too many steps. For a product designed to help you relax and simplify your sleep routine, using the app is surprisingly frustrating.

reviews.title: Such a scam
reviews.text:
It’s such a scam that you spend $170 on an ALARM CLOCK, but then to get the full use of it, you have to pay for $70/yr subscription?? Just for it to play more noises??? Like what the actual F. I can’t even try listening to a different bird chirping without it being locked behind a pay wall. Companies like hatch really don’t care about costumer satisfaction and it’s extremely disappointing. They only care about squeezing every dollar they can out of their consumers. 

It’s a bummer because I do honestly like the sunrise feature of the clock, but I never recommend it to anyone because I find the business model so stupid and greedy. The clock itself is already $170. If it came with the full features, I would say that it’s worth it and I would recommend it to everyone I know. But I just can’t get behind the greediness of putting alarm sounds behind a pay wall. Everything these days requires a subscription and I’m frankly sick of it. Do better Hatch. 

On top of this, the app is extremely glitchy. I try to edit old alarms and when I try to scroll, it’ll change the alarm to a random time - like sending to my 5:30 alarm to 8:15pm. It’s like it has a mind of its own. It also doesn’t always save new alarms I enter or save changes I’ve made to alarms. There have been a few times where I haven’t realized that my alarm didn’t save, and then my hatch doesn’t wake me up in the morning. I’ve had the app for awhile and have had it through multiple updates, but unfortunately there have been no changes to the glitching.

reviews.title: Laggy sleep for everyone
reviews.text: I love this device. When it works….. I purchased this to have a calmer, more relaxed morning as I rise and open my eyes. However, between the yelling personal trainer telling me to get up and that he’s already had a protein shake or my alarm just not going off… it’s been more of a stressful morning. Please fix the glitches and make more alarms that are actually relaxing

reviews.title: Easier to drive to the ocean for noise
reviews.text: So you bought a Hatch. Do you want to update it in any way? Change the clock, update a schedule, or anything you’d assume would be easy? Well too bad. Get ready to reset and re-register your device. Have your WiFi password copied somewhere cause you’ll enter it 10 times when the reset process inevitably fails. Get ready to repeat the process any time the device gets unplugged or the power goes out.

reviews.title: Great in theory - TERRIBLE app
reviews.text: I’ve had the Restore 3 since June. I bought it for my summer house and used it for a couple of weeks in June. Loved it. It was a soothing way to wake up and I enjoyed the white noise and soundscapes. Came back in August and haven’t been able to connect to it for over a week. It has the old alarm schedule built in so it goes off every morning anyway but the time display is off by 20 minutes. Super annoying. And there is nothing I can do to change any of it. It simply refuses to connect. I’ve used it for all of a couple weeks, total. And I have lightning fast WiFi. This thing is frustrating beyond belief.

reviews.title: Slow app
reviews.text: It needs to be quicker in loading when launching the app. And when you leave the app and come back it’s never on the page you left it and have to to back and re pick it and wait for it to load again

reviews.title: app is the worst
reviews.text: i honestly love the alarm, the app however i hate. if i want to turn off an alarm it will pop up again and i have to turn it off AGAIN! there are times when the app refuses to work properly and i have to leave it and refresh for it to just end up doing what i wanted it to in the first place. please fix the app

reviews.title: Goods nights rest, stress on app
reviews.text: Good luck ever getting the app to work. It’s terribly slow, and god forbid your hatch ever needs a firmware update. Congrats on your new paper weight.

reviews.title: Product good. App BAD
reviews.text:
I have never written an app review before but I had to for this app. It is SO glitchy. Takes forever to load. Once it loads you must make your changes immediately without switching to another app because if you switch apps and go back IT DOESNT WORK. You have to close the app and reopen. Every. Single. Time. My other gripe is..why can’t I delete old devices?? I was a nanny for several families and I CANNOT delete their devices. I emailed about it 5 years ago and was told I have to send the MAC address so they could go in and delete it for me. WHY??? It’s 2026. Why can’t I delete myself yet?? 
Overall not well maintained app and it needs a major overhaul. It is way past due. Hire a new team of developers because whoever is in charge is being lulled to sleep on the job to the sound of ocean waves

reviews.title: Impossible to keep connected!!!!
reviews.text: I’m in my second device after the first had hardware issues. Some settings will only work over WiFi, not Bluetooth and it has been so frustrating trying to use this device through moves and travel. The app is essentially useless because it won’t stay connected to the device

reviews.title: Too slow
reviews.text: Please update your app so it has a drop down menu for the song list.  It takes 5 minutes to cycle through all the songs. I have to wait several seconds before I can move to the next song.  This makes the process extremely frustrating.

reviews.title: Hatch Alarm NOT working
reviews.text:
I loved using the Hatch Alarm at first. I bought a second one for my son it was so great, but now my Hatch sleep sound isn’t playing in the routine that I have set up less than a month after getting it. I’m so disappointed and I don’t know how to fix it! 

I’ve also been woken up on several occasions from it going from rain sounds to suddenly making a buzzing sound like a defective machine. It’s too expensive to be malfunctioning less than a month into owning it.

reviews.title: No Christian Mediations
reviews.text: If hatch and the Hallow app could work together, i would LOVE, but right now I’m having trouble finding things I like on this app alone…

reviews.title: Wish there was more flexibility
reviews.text: I just wish there were a bit more flexibility in the functions. For example, I can only set one master “cue to unwind”, but my schedule is genuinely different during weeknights and weekends. I don’t know why we can’t set different cue times for different days, it’s quite frustrating when I want my routine to vary by just an hour each night without wasting electricity on the weekends. Also, there seems to be no way for me to enter “cue to unwind” manually or set the color-changing lights. It’s a good app/alarm clock but the functionality is really lacking :/

reviews.title: Painfully slow
reviews.text:
App takes forever to load, god forbid you don’t have your Bluetooth on, turning it back on doesn’t recognize your phone.
Have to kill the app and start over again. Brutal

reviews.title: Shows too many sounds what we cannot play
reviews.text:
The app is good, but I strongly dislike the user interface of the app because I have to click so many times to be able to play some sounds. As an iOS developer it’s a pain to use the app. 

For example, enter the home screen, click a category of sounds (alarm or sleep), scroll and click a sound I like, in that sound page I click play. If I want a different sound, there’s no back button to go back to the list of sounds. It should be simple for me to listen to what a “brown noise” sounds like to a “laundry dryer noise” to compare which sleep sound I wanna play. 

I suggest Hatch to make the app flow again. Consider playing preview of a sound on the list of sounds. Instead of needing tho to list of sounds -> picked sound -> play page.

reviews.title: Lags a lot
reviews.text: I used to really enjoy using the Hatch Alarm but it lags too much now. Every time I try to add a new alarm and it takes about a minute to load and will still give me an error notification. Everything within the application lags or does not work. Very dissatisfied with the application and currently looking for other options to replace it.

reviews.title: App sucks
reviews.text: I love having the light come on automatically so my kids know when it's morning and they can get up. But the app is absolutely horrible. It's a giant hassle to change anything and often it won't save changes

reviews.title: Why is this so large?
reviews.text: Unit works great but app is laggy. It also takes up over 1.5GB of storage on my phone. How is that possible?!?

reviews.title: Worst product ever
reviews.text: Does this product ever work?

reviews.title: Unreliable & Cringey
reviews.text: App is slow. They barely ever upload new content. Not misophonia friendly. Majority of content is made with condenser mics.

reviews.title: Do Not Recommend
reviews.text: Not only are you paying for a $200 alarm clock but you’re paying monthly for an app that DOESNT EVEN WORK. No matter what it will not connect to my product. It will randomly work for a couple of days then decide to disconnect again. I’ve moved WiFi routers, deleted, logged out, and updated the app. This has been an ongoing issue for months. It’s one thing if you can change the alarm time on the device itself, but forget it, you have to use the app that never works. I bought this for nursing school which starts in August and can’t even set my alarm for school. Genuinely this app and product has become the most frustrating thing and I can’t bring myself to toss it because of the price. So I will keep holding onto hope something gets fixed. Wish me luck!

reviews.title: Volume issues
reviews.text: My volume is set on my routines yet each time it resets to a louder volume. It didn’t used to be a problem, help!

reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text: Garbage. Never works. Ever. Biggest waste of a product regret purchasing.

reviews.title: light problems
reviews.text: multiple lights not showing on clock. unwind routines custom light selection keep reverting back to suggested.

reviews.title: Adult hatch ($$$) lacks features of baby hatch ($)
reviews.text:
It’s frustrating that the adult hatch lacks the ability to schedule on sleep sounds, which the baby hatch can do. Adult hatch can only schedule wind down cues, but you have to press the button for your sleep sounds. The app is way more complicated than it needs to be, and basic features are missing. 

Simply adding the same sleep sound scheduling would bring my review to at least 4 stars, maybe 5.

reviews.title: Brick
reviews.text: Hatch switched to a subscription plan and essentially bricked our device. Can’t play anything via the app or the touch ring. Now we just have a basic clock.

reviews.title: Please fix the app
reviews.text: Like the device, but app is so slow and laggy and frequently freezing asking for feedback.

reviews.title: Like the concept, not the app
reviews.text: Love the concept, but hate the app. It’s so slow, lags, and disconnects randomly/at the worst time.

reviews.title: Lag
reviews.text: Laggy so so laggy. Every time I close out of the app it completely restarts and takes forever to reopen when I need it.

reviews.title: Horrible app for such an expensive product
reviews.text: This app lags and/or never opens on a daily basis. It is HIGHLY FRUSTRATING.  I just want to ensure I have the correct alarm set before bed and spend forever trying to get it to open. Sometimes I just turn the alarm clock off because it won’t load. An absolute waste. For such an expensive alarm this app is a disgrace. It needs an update asap.

reviews.title: Alarm is great. App is slow
reviews.text: There are some moments that the app doesn’t load & I can’t change the alarm time. It can be a hassle

reviews.title: Just get the off-brand knockoff
reviews.text:
The Hatch device itself is fine, but the paid subscription feels hard to justify when the music library is barely the size of a CD. For families with toddlers who don't need sleep coaching or an AI chat, “Hatch+” means you're essentially paying a premium for maybe 10 songs on repeat. I'd happily pay more for an actual library of quality instrumental music — and if licensing costs are the barrier, it might be worth reconsidering where the development budget is going. More music, fewer features I didn't ask for. For anyone with a good sleeper or a toddler/older child, just get the $20 sound machine from Amazon. 

By the way, Hatch’s in-app AI assistant wrote this review for me. At least it’s good for something!

reviews.title: App sucks, clock is great
reviews.text: The Hatch itself is amazing. The app has seriously been slacking. Never loads on the first try and I have to close out and reopen multiple times. I also wish there was a better way to switch between devices.

reviews.title: Never add new sleep sounds
reviews.text: For a device with one of its main functionalities being a “white noise” machine, they NEVER add new sleep sounds. Always adding stuff I don’t care about but in the YEARS I’ve been using my restore like 3 sounds have been added to the already small library of sleep sounds. Literally any other app has waaaay more options and better quality. This prevents me from using it much anymore.

reviews.title: Connection issues on app
reviews.text: Won’t allow me to reconnect my hatch to WiFi . Even when I haven’t disconnected the Hatch from my WiFi not once , and my Bluetooth is always on. Super inconvenient.

reviews.title: Love the alarm, app could improve
reviews.text:
Waking up with this alarm has genuinely changed my life, but I think that the app needs a lot of work. It was overall confusing at first to figure out how to navigate the app which is the first change I think needs to be made.

Second, I think that product will be so much better if you could create a morning routine along with a night routine. 

Also hatch if you’re reading this I think that you should partner with a music and audiobook platform or just install Bluetooth into the alarm clock so that users can listen to their own music or audiobooks because the unwind selections are not good at all

reviews.title: Worst garbage
reviews.text: This is the worst garbage i have seen in a long time. The website, app, and "helpful" videos are a nightmare to actually use. And the product itself has buggy features. ALSO it doesn't even play music unless you pay for the danged subscription!

reviews.title: Sound keeps changing
reviews.text: Sound keeps changing without any intervention. Tried to save new volume but keeps changing with each use

reviews.title: Not falling for this. Money hungry liars….
reviews.text:
I didn’t download this app, I just want to make a statement because I hate what’s happening here. The alarm clock for this app is already WAY too expensive for just an alarm clock, and then they still want you to pay them MORE money because they made a subscription for this app as well. I can’t understand how this would actually be successful in any way! If you want more money, how about you make your alarm clocks cheaper so more people will buy them? There is no reason why an alarm clock should be this expensive. I mean, come on…. EVERYONE wants to wake up and feel refreshed. And you are just using that to your advantage! This shouldn’t exist!
And if you want to buy this alarm clock BECAUSE it’s expensive, let me just tell you that nobody cares if your alarm clock is a “luxury” brand… they just want to wake up! And quit with the subscriptions as well, there’s way too many of them on every single app nowadays… i prefer one-time purchases, but not something very expensive…. 
My final statement is that there are similar products on Amazon for about a third of the price of this one, even though I still don’t know why it’s that expensive. Bye.
(5 stars so more people can see this.)

reviews.title: I think we’re past the issues w/ the iOS 26 jump
reviews.text:
8/2/26
I must be in another loop where I have to update my phone. Hatch has disconnected. I cannot get it connected to WiFi to connect the app. It’s frustrating that is so depends on the wifi connection. Since I wake up at different times week to week, I just shut off the alarm with the hard switch. It wil still my windown routine at 9:00 PM, and the two other ones I set up after. I can still have my waves overnight. But still, it’s not working as intended. I hate that 1 update or me owning an SE Apple phone causes me to have an app breaking experience. Sigh. 

Previous:
Update since the developers reached out to me: Five stars, all is well. I have Rise set to wake a little later just in case. But so far Hatch has woken me up every day. I didn’t even remember that I was having an issue!

I like the cue setting. I’d like it more if we could rotate through presets like we do with the bedtime routines. Sometimes I just want to push play. 

I have 3 bedtime routines and I love it. One I use every night, the others are a different vibe, brightness and length if I want to switch it up or use on the weekends. Having a strict 10 min + 10 min routine is helping me get sleepy. Then on the weekends, I can relax a little longer. 

I didn’t know if this would end up feeling like a gimmick. I think the jury is still out on things like blue blockers, but as someone with ADHD, 4 concussions and a decade of not knowing any of the science at all- adding this to my life has been a game changer. I smiled every night when I headed to bed the first week. I kid you not. It gave me a routine, a ritual. I can’t believe I survived my 20’s. And 5 1/2 years of chronically, miserably sick. It’s so nice to feel like my life and my heart and my peace are falling into place. I was lost for so many years. And now we have such an exchange of ideas and can live better, simpler, happier. And Hatch has become a joyful part of that. 

****************
I’ll be nice because I have a feeling iOS 26 has screwed up my phone. Apps keep crashing. Same with Hatch last night. But what Hatch just did was not the alarm setup I had. There was no light. Only gentle piano music. I had the light set for Iike 27. The alarm had no light. Sigh. Now I’ll be late for work.

reviews.title: Great Alarm, Terrible Delivery
reviews.text:
I actually really enjoy this alarm clock. It’s easy to use, the sound quality is excellent, it looks great on my nightstand, and the sunrise light feature is fantastic. The hardware is genuinely excellent. 
The subscription is what ruins it. This is already an expensive alarm clock, yet so many alarm sounds and features are locked behind a monthly fee. You’re pushed into starting a free trial with your credit card, and when it ends, the free experience is extremely limited.
It’s also frustrating that the free and paid content is mixed together, making it difficult to tell what you can actually use without subscribing.
I wanted to love this product, but I’m honestly considering getting rid of it because of the subscription model. The hardware deserves 5 stars. The greedy subscription ruins it all.

I also try to toggle alarms on or off, and they don’t move to be inactive or active. Then I quit the app and reopen and it shows that it actually did move to be on/off (whichever I selected). It’s unreliable. I am shocked if I can just toggle one of my alarms to be on and it automatically moves to the active section and saves. 

If I tried to turn two alarms on at once, I sometimes just see the error “ try again later” or “oops” without clear indications of what’s happening.

reviews.title: So mad!
reviews.text: We have the rest+, and after only a couple months, part of the display didn’t work which made it hard to tell the time. This was when our son was still a newborn so it hadn’t been dropped or messed with. We were too sleep deprived to do anything about it then. Now our son is 2 years old and while we were traveling, the noise he typically listens was getting choppy and stopping working. I get that a speaker that always plays the same sound can burn out the speaker, so although I’m annoyed it was having issues at 1 am, that’s not what makes me so mad. What makes me absolutely livid is that at 1am while in a hotel room, this expensive noise machine wouldn’t let me change what noise it would make because it wasn’t connected to the wifi. It was connected to my phone via Bluetooth and my phone was connected to wifi, but because I couldn’t get the hatch rest+ connected to the Hilton wifi, I couldn’t switch the noise to something that the speaker could still do. This is insane!!! When you pay over 100$ for a noise machine, you better be able to use it as a noise machine without having it connected to WiFi. I will never buy a hatch product again. I would have been better off with some cheap noise machine from Amazon.

reviews.title: Almost Perfect!!!
reviews.text:
This app is almost the best app ever made for my struggle to wake up and sleep. The only things I have an issue with are:

1. When I turn the switch off on the alarm, it deletes it. I had my alarm set perfectly to my standards for waking up, and when I had a day off, there is a switch to toggle it on or off and there is a different switch to delete it. So when I clicked the toggle it deleted my alarm.

2. I had a Kids Rest + for years because I really never felt like getting another one. Now, when I upgraded to a Restore 3, the lullaby sound wasn’t there anymore. I know that’s pretty foolish to say as a 15 year old, but hey, that lullaby really put me to sleep!!!

Other than that the app and product are amazing!! Great work developers and keep working hard! 👍🏻
